props.name: close
props.description:
Display a close button to dismiss the modal. Pass an object to forward
props to the underlying `VyButton`.

props.name: closeIcon
props.description: Iconify name for the close button.

props.name: description
props.description: Modal description text. Overridden by the `description` slot.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: When `false`, the modal will not close when interacting outside.

props.name: overlay
props.description: Render an overlay behind the modal.

props.name: title
props.description: Modal title text. Overridden by the `title` slot.

props.name: transition
props.description: Animate the modal when opening or closing.

slots.name: default
slots.description:
Trigger element — wrapped in `DialogTrigger`, which toggles open state on
tap. Do NOT also bind a `@tap` handler that sets the open state; use
`v-model:open` instead.

slots.name: content
slots.description:
Full content override — replaces the default header/body/footer layout,
including the close button. Matches Nuxt UI's Modal `#content`.

slots.name: header
slots.description: Header region. Replaces title / description / close.
